basic_info.description: Lovely one bedroom, one bath condo, that has been recently updated with fresh paint, all new stainless steel appliances, including range, microwave, dishwasher, and refrigerator. The large living room has wood floors, and an abundance of natural light. There is a sizable bedroom with new carpet, large walk-in closet, and patio with sliding glass door.  Brand new washer and dryer in the unit, and one car deeded parking.  Close to SF State, Stonestown, BART, Public transportation and easy access to freeway.  Great commute location.
